title: F-16 Barrier Pull Engagement
description: 177th Fighter Wing firefighters, power production and civilian personnel work together at the Atlantic City International Airport, N.J., Feb. 9, 2019, to test the system designed to ensure that military aircraft are able to stop safely during a landing roll or a no-go during high speed takeoff. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Senior Airman Cristina J. Allen)
